source.name: Samoilov2004/premier_league_dataset; squad records derived from Transfermarkt
source.notes: Season is keyed by start year. This is a third-party historical roster dataset; its repository does not show an explicit license. Review Transfermarkt terms and applicable rights before public/commercial redistribution. Player attributes are preserved as sourced; ageAtSeasonStart is derived from dateOfBirth as of 2023-08-01. Team IDs are API-Football IDs; sourceClubId is the upstream dataset's club ID.
